title: UK public sector finances, August 2026 (ONS, 07:00 London / 02:00 ET) — the borrowing print that is actually inside the Budget's forecast, and the one that re-bases the series
source: EST: ons.gov.uk/releases/publicsectorfinancesukaugust2026, fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200) — the ONS release-calendar entry reads verbatim 'Public sector finances, UK: August 2026', '22 September 2026 at 7:00am', marked 'This release is not yet published.' Corroborated by publication-cadence arithmetic on the publisher's own past-release listing: 70 consecutive PSF bulletins from 2020-11-20 to 2026-08-21 all fall on the 19th-26th of the month. Filed estimate on the taxonomy gap (no confirmed prefix covers a foreign national statistics institute) and this lane's no-self-confirm limit. Discovered in the never-assessed initial research of uk-public-sector-finances-2026-10-21, 2026-09-09
notes: PROPOSED BY THE uk-public-sector-finances-2026-10-21 LANE, 2026-09-09. Two reasons, and the first is the proposing lane's central finding. (1) PLACEMENT: this — not the 10-21 print — is the last UK borrowing outturn that can plausibly sit inside the 2026-10-28 Budget's OBR forecast. The OBR's November 2025 EFO closed its final pre-measures FISCAL forecast determinants over the ten working days to 2025-10-21, 36 days before that Budget; its October 2024 EFO finalised the pre-measures forecast 2024-09-26, 34 days before the 2024-10-30 Budget. Projecting 34-36 days back from 2026-10-28 lands on 2026-09-22 to 2026-09-24 — this print sits on the boundary and the 10-21 print sits four weeks past it (both precedents search-relayed; obr.uk 403s this lane). (2) MECHANICS: the ONS's July 2026 bulletin (fetched 2026-09-09) states that the September 2026 release carries the annual data updates — pension fund liability estimates, equity valuation in multilateral development banks, central government lease modelling, and the Scottish National Investment Bank's classification into the UK public sector. So this print re-bases the level of the series every later bulletin is read against, including the 10-21 one. Tiered LOW on the same measured null as its proposer: 70 PSF release days since 2020-11-20 move IGLT.L 1.14x an ordinary day (t = 1.02) and the US 10y 0.90x. symbols: [], no fiscal- or sterling-keyed house playbook. Estimate widens caution only.
